spans.s: प्रिय (I) a. (f. या; compar. प्रेयस्; super. प्रेष्ठ) 1. Dear, beloved, R.iii.29; 2. agreeable, pleading, R.xii.92; 3. fond of; 4. attached to, addicted to.
प्रिय (II) m. 1. A husband, a lover, Megh.i.30; 2. a kind of deer.

प्रिय (III) n. 1. A favour, a kindness, मत्प्रियार्थं यियासोः Megh.i.22; 2. pleasure, धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः Bg.i.23.(प्रियम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘in an agreeable way.’)
प्रिय (I) a. (f. या; compar. प्रेयस्; super. प्रेष्ठ) 1. Dear, beloved, R.iii.29; 2. agreeable, pleading, R.xii.92; 3. fond of; 4. attached to, addicted to.
प्रिया f. 1. A wife, a mistress, निदाघकालः समुपागतः प्रिये Bt.i.1, R.ii.68; 2. a woman in general; 3. news, information; 4. a kind of jasmine; 5. small cardamoms.
प्रिय-अपाय m. loss of a beloved object.
प्रिय-अप्रिय (I) a. agreeable and disagreeable.
प्रिय-अप्रिय (II) n. 1. pleasure and pain, agreeable and disagreeable feelings; 2. kindness and injury.
प्रिय-अंबु m. the mango tree.
प्रिय-अर्ह a. amiable.
प्रिय-असु a. fond of life.
प्रिय-आख्य a. giving good tidings.
प्रिय-आख्यान n. agreeable news.
प्रिय-आत्मन् a. pleasant, agreeable.
प्रिय-उक्ति f. friendly speech.
प्रिय-उपपत्ति f. a pleasant occurrence.
प्रिय-उपभोग m. the enjoyment of a lover or mistress, R.xii.22.
प्रिय-एषिन् a. friendly, desirous of doing good, desirous of pleasing.
प्रिय-कर्मन् a. one who acts kindly.
प्रिय-कलत्र m. a man who is fond of his wife.
प्रिय-काम a. desirous of doing good, friendly disposed.
प्रियंकर a. 1. acting kindly, प्रियंकरो मे प्रिय इत्यनंदत् R.xiv.48; 2. amiable, agreeable.
प्रियंकर a. 1. acting kindly, प्रियंकरो मे प्रिय इत्यनंदत् R.xiv.48; 2. amiable, agreeable.
प्रियंकर a. 1. acting kindly, प्रियंकरो मे प्रिय इत्यनंदत् R.xiv.48; 2. amiable, agreeable.
प्रिय-कारिन् a. acting kindly, showing kindness to.
प्रिय-कृत् m. a friend, a benefactor.
प्रिय-जन m. a beloved person.
प्रिया-जन m. a beloved woman.
प्रिय-जानि m. a man who is fond of his wife.
प्रिय-तम m. a lover, a husband, शिप्रावातः प्रियतम इव प्रार्थनाचाटुकारः Megh.i.31.
प्रिय-तमा f. a wife, a mistress.
प्रिय-ता f. love, affection.
प्रिय-तोषण m. a particular form of sexual enjoyment.
प्रिय-दर्श a. agreeable to look at.
प्रिय-दर्शन (I) a. agreeable to look at, lovely, handsome, R.i.47.
प्रिय-दर्शन (II) m. 1. a parrot; 2. a kind of date tree; 3. name of a principal Gandharva, R.v.53.
प्रिय-देवन a. fond of gambling.
प्रिय-धन्व m. an epithet or Śiva.
प्रिय-पुत्र m. a kind of bird.
प्रिय-प्रसादन n. the conciliation of a husband.
प्रिय-प्राय n. eloquence.
प्रिय-प्रायस् n. a lover’s speech.
प्रिय-प्रेप्सु a. desirous of gaining a beloved object.
प्रिय-भाषण n. kind words.
प्रिय-मंडन a. fond of ornaments, नादत्ते प्रियमंडनापि भवतां स्नेहेन या पल्लवम् Sak.iv.
प्रिय-मधु m. an epithet of Balarāma (who was very fond of wine).
प्रियंभविष्णु a. becoming dear, becoming an object of affection.
प्रियंभविष्णु a. becoming dear, becoming an object of affection.
प्रिय-रण a. warlike, martial.
प्रिय-वचन (I) a. speaking kind words.
प्रिय-वचन (II) n. an endearing expression.
प्रियंवद (I) a. shaking kindly, agreeable, R.iii.64, K.S.v.28.
प्रियंवद (II) m. 1. name of a Gandharva, R.v.53; 2. a kind of bird.
प्रिय-वयस्य m. a dear friend.
प्रिय-वर्णी f. the priyangu creeper.
प्रिय-वस्तु n. a beloved thing.
प्रिय-वाच् f. a kind of speech.
प्रिय-वादिका f. A kind of musical instrument.
प्रिय-वादिन् a. speaking kindly or agreeably.
प्रिय-श्रवस् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
प्रिय-संवास m. the society of a beloved person.
प्रिय-सख m. a dear friend, Megh.i.12.
प्रिय-सखी f. a female friend, a confidante.
प्रिय-सत्य a. pleasant though true.
प्रिय-संदेश m. 1. the champaka tree; 2. the message of a lover.
प्रिय-समागम m. union with a beloved object.
प्रिय-सहचरी f. a beloved wife.
प्रिय-सुहृद् m. a dear friend.
प्रिय-स्वप्न a. fond of sleep, R.xii.81.
प्रियक m. 1. A kind of deer, Sis.iv.32; 2. a bee; 3. the nīpa tree; 4. saffron; 5. priyangu creeper.
प्रियंगु (I) m.f. 1. Name of a creeper, लग्नः प्रियंगुलतयेव तरुस्तमालः Bh.V.iv.8; 2. long pepper.
प्रियंगु (II) n. Saffron.
प्रियाल m. the same as पियाल q.v.
प्रियाला f. A vine.
प्री (I) vi. 4Ā (pres. प्रीयते) 1. To feel affection; 2. to be gratified, विश्वे देवाश्च प्रीयंताम् Yaj.i.245; 3. to be satisfied, to assent.

प्री (II) vt. or vi. 10U (pp. प्रीत; pres. प्रीणाति, प्रीणीते; caus. प्रीणयति-ते) 1. To please, to delight, to gladden, प्रीणाति यः सुचरितैः पितरं स पुत्रः Bhartr.ii.68, Bt.v.104, iii.38; 2. to take delight in, e.g. कच्चिन्मन्सस्ते प्रीणाति वनवासे; 3. to show kindness to, to act kindly towards.
प्रीण a. (f. णा) 1. Pleased, satisfied; 2. old, ancient.
प्रीण a. (f. णा) 1. Pleased, satisfied; 2. old, ancient.
प्रीणन n. 1. Pleasing, satisfying; 2. anything that satisfies.
प्रीत a. (f. ता) 1. Pleased, delighted, gladdened, R.i.81, iii.63; 2. content; 3. glad, happy, R.xii.94, Megh.i.4; 4. dear, beloved; 5. kind, affectionate, (pp. of प्री q.v.).
प्रीत a. (f. ता) 1. Pleased, delighted, gladdened, R.i.81, iii.63; 2. content; 3. glad, happy, R.xii.94, Megh.i.4; 4. dear, beloved; 5. kind, affectionate, (pp. of प्री q.v.).
प्रीत-आत्मन्, -मनस् a. pleased at heart.
प्रीत-आत्मन्, -मनस् a. pleased at heart.

प्रीति f. 1. Joy, gladness, happiness, K.S.ii.45, R.ii.51; 2. satisfaction, gratification; 3. kindness, favour; 4. liking, fondness, affection, lore, R.i.57, xii.54, M.ix.168; 5. a wife of Kāmadeva (co-wife of Rati).
प्रीति-कर्मन् n. an act of love or friendship.
प्रीति-द m. a buffoon in a play.
प्रीति-दत्त (I) a. given through affection.
प्रीति-दत्त (II) n. property presented to a woman by her father-in-law or mother-in-law, (प्रीत्या दत्तं तु यत्किंचिच्छ्वाश्र्वा वा श्वशुरेण वा । पादवंदनिकं चैव प्रीतिदत्तं तदुच्यते Kātyāyana).
प्रीति-दान n. a present made from love.
प्रीति-दाय m. a present made from love.
प्रीति-धन n. money given out of friendship.
प्रीति-पात्र n. a beloved person or thing.
प्रीति-पूर्वम्, -पूर्वकम् ind. affectionately, kindly.
प्रीति-पूर्वम्, -पूर्वकम् ind. affectionately, kindly.
प्रीति-मनस् a. pleased in mind, happy.
प्रीति-वचस् n. a friendly speech.
प्रीति-वर्धन (I) a. increasing joy.
प्रीति-वर्धन (II) m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रीति-विवाह m. a love-marriage.
प्रीति-श्राद्ध n. a kind of funeral offering to the Manes of both parents.
